summary: A WAL checkpoint that waits 100 ms or more for the writer names the longest writer hold that held it up

replay.detail: No claim, projection or cache changes; nothing is replayed or rebuilt.

schema.detail: No table, index, view, trigger or storage version changes; the accounting is in memory.

rules.detail: Checkpoint scheduling, TRUNCATE and its writer turn are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire, client or stored-format change. The daemon's WAL checkpoint log line gains report.blocked_by (holder, client, at, kind, held_ms, holds) or null; WalCheckpointReport gains the matching optional field.

recovery.detail: Rolling back removes the field from the log line; nothing else changes.
